prompt: Ice skating race against three rivals around the frozen lake

intent.setting: A vast, frozen lake encircled by snowy snowbanks and distant pines, with a wide, smooth ice surface and a marked oval track.
intent.goal: Win the race against three rival skaters by completing the laps around the frozen lake in the shortest time.
intent.fail: Slipping into the icy water or being lapped behind the last-place rival.
intent.headline: Racer must maintain speed and stay on the ice track despite slippery ice physics
